compute.reported_as: We estimated the ground state energy for the square-lattice J1-J2 model for linear cluster sizes L = 10, 12, 16. We used GCNNs with L layers, each consisting of six group-indexed feature maps. For most simulations, we performed 1000 SR steps using 1024 Monte Carlo samples, followed by 500 steps with 4096 samples. All simulations were carried out on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.

compute.reported_as: Sec. II.A: In this work, all calculations use the same aCNN architecture with 30 layers (14 residual blocks) unless otherwise stated. The activation function f is chosen to be ReLU ... The middle layer has 3 channels, and the kernel size is 5×5. ... The actual amount of computation is in proportion to the number of lattice size. The number of (real-valued) parameters of the aCNN is 6538. All tests in this article were performed on an Nvidia 3090 GPU. ... Sec. II.B: we only discuss the optimization of amplitude, and choose to use the popular Adam algorithm [44] ... The amplitude network is optimized until the loss function no longer drops. ... Sec. II.C: In the case of limited computing resources, although C4v symmetry achieved by data augmentation will limit the size of configuration batch allowed in a single training step, data augmentation itself does not limit the number of the network's parameters. ... Sec. III: the aCNN contains 6538 real-valued parameters. ... Acknowledgments: Computational resources were provided by the Physical Laboratory of High Performance Computing at Renmin University of China.
